source.title: Spaulders of the Wayward Vanquisher — seven T8 reward variants
source.author: Warcraft Wiki contributors

notes: Seven class-restricted T8 10-player shoulder reward IDs independently matched to Wowhead item pages. Live 45661 tooltip says 'Use: Create a class set item appropriate for your loot specialization' (https://www.wowhead.com/item=45661/spaulders-of-the-wayward-vanquisher), while historic redemption used Dalaran vendors. Modern use is specialization-gated; seven historical rewards are not simultaneously available from one click. Distinguish this token from 25-player Mantle of the Wayward Vanquisher. Current Wowhead live variant item-level 14; historic version item-level 80.
vendor: Historical vendor redemption: Dubin Clay (Death Knight), Valerie Langrom (Rogue/Druid), Paldesse (Mage), Dalaran
